Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical genealogical reasoning error by confusing the maternal grandmother with the paternal grandmother. After correctly identifying Blanche's father as Afonso III and his mother as Urraca of Castile (which would make Urraca the paternal grandmother), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the answer was "Dulce of Aragon." Dulce of Aragon was the mother of Afonso II (Blanche's great-grandmother), not the mother of Afonso III. The Planner failed to verify the specific parentage of Afonso III against the retrieved evidence (which explicitly stated Afonso III was the son of Afonso II and Urraca of Castile) and instead hallucinated a different ancestor as the grandmother.
